MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

2. Solve for x: x + 7 = 13. (1 mark)

   B. 6
   C. 13
   D. 7

3. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15
   C. 15.7
   D. 21

4. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 2/2
   D. 1/4

   C. 7
   D. 19

   D. 2

9. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
